verdict.rationale: Apify exposes a full REST API with OpenAPI spec, official JS/Python API clients, and a CLI that together cover developing, running, scheduling, monitoring, and publishing Actors, tasks, webhooks, and datasets—mirroring UI capabilities (apify-docs-1,3,15,16,23,29,32; apify-probe-2,4). Docs explicitly frame Actors/tasks/webhooks as programmatically manageable equivalents of UI actions, and community feedback corroborates the API/SDK/CLI ecosystem as mature and heavily used. missing for 10: explicit 1:1 feature parity matrix confirming every UI-only setting (e.g., billing/org management, some Store publishing UI flows) is scriptable, and independent hands-on confirmation of full parity beyond docs.
